verification.source: Derived from shipped Jetpack Compose source (ui/theme, ui/components, ui/screens, ui/SxvApp.kt, res/font).
verification.note: No Android SDK on the documenting machine; Material-drawn shapes (navigation indicator, switch) are unverified on device.

display-large.purpose: Speed in the header box only; capped against system font scale so three digits fit.

display-small.purpose: Live trip distance role; the roll draws it at 28sp to fit the distance column.

headline-small.purpose: Screen titles and the SXV wordmark.

title-large.purpose: NOW row title and logged row distances (tabular).

title-medium.purpose: Row titles, toggle titles, preset and recent messages, field input.

body-large.purpose: Base for the cluster preview line (drawn at 20sp, 2sp tracking).

body-small.purpose: Notes, disabled reasons, empty states, log lines.

label-medium.purpose: Tags, text actions, nav labels, status label, units; upper-case.

label-small.purpose: Typewritten box labels, timestamps, detail keys; upper-case.

rules.name: rule-heavy
rules.purpose: Outer frame of every box, press block, nav separator, roll column separator.

rules.name: rule-light
rules.purpose: Row and column separators inside a box; fuel cell outlines; scale marks.

rules.name: press-inset
rules.purpose: How far a pressed block's inked face sinks inside its rule.

rules.name: min-touch
rules.purpose: Minimum height of every tappable control.

rules.name: distance-column
rules.purpose: Roadbook distance column; widened to fit 8888.8 at the NOW size plus 22dp.

motion.name: motion-gate
motion.purpose: rememberMotionEnabled(); every decorative motion below is skipped when false. Live trip distance still updates because it is data.

motion.name: rolling-digits
motion.value: slide 320ms FastOutSlowIn + fade 160ms, per changed digit, up when rising, down when falling
motion.purpose: Speed, engine temperature and NOW distance change like an odometer.

motion.name: temp-needle
motion.purpose: 4dp highlighter needle slides along the 40-120 °C scale to the reported temperature.

motion.name: distance-ticks
motion.value: 12dp per 10 m, long tick per 100 m, driven by dead-reckoned trip
motion.purpose: The roll's left strip scrolls at riding speed.

motion.name: dead-reckoning
motion.value: advance at reported speed inside the 0.1 km band, max 6 s extrapolation, ease up over ~350ms, never backwards, reset on >1 km drop
motion.purpose: Keeps the NOW distance moving between 5-second frames without inventing distance.

motion.name: tulip-flow
motion.value: dash 9dp / gap 6.3dp, ~1 cycle/s at 40 km/h, scaled linearly with speed
motion.purpose: The live Moving tulip's highlighter shaft flows with the bike; static dash when motion is off.

motion.name: connect-breathe
motion.purpose: Status square breathes only while connecting.

motion.name: press
motion.value: inset spring damping 0.6 stiffness 1800; face colour tween 90ms; VirtualKey haptic
motion.purpose: Press blocks flood with ink and sink 3dp.

motion.name: new-row-swipe
motion.value: highlighter 40% alpha sweep 520ms FastOutSlowIn, hold 1400ms, dry 900ms; newest row written within 4 s only
motion.purpose: Marks a freshly logged roadbook row like a highlighter pass.

motion.name: row-placement
motion.purpose: Logged rows slide into place as new rows arrive.

breakpoints.name: landscape
breakpoints.purpose: Two columns (status + header 1, roll 1.15), NavigationRail behind a heavy rule.

states.name: offline
states.treatment: Empty ink status square; NOW row 'Offline' with Connect press block; header readings Soft Ink + STALE if last values exist.

states.name: connecting
states.treatment: Breathing highlighter square; NOW row 'Connecting' with paper Cancel block.

states.name: error
states.treatment: Ink square crossed in paper; NOW row 'Link failed' pointing to Logs; Try again block.

states.name: waiting
states.treatment: Linked but no frame yet: 'Linked' row, Connected tulip, distance '—'.

states.name: riding
states.treatment: NOW row in Highlighter Wash with NOW tag; flowing tulip; distance rolls.

states.name: stopped
states.treatment: NOW row in wash, Stopped tulip with highlighter bar.

states.name: stale
states.treatment: Readings Soft Ink, STALE tag in header, 'No data' row, age line turns Ink.

states.name: low-fuel
states.treatment: Two bars: LOW tag and highlighter cells. One bar or fewer: RESERVE tag and highlighter cells.

states.name: empty-roadbook
states.treatment: Body Small Soft Ink note under the NOW row.

narrative.overview:
The app is a rally roadbook: a white paper roll ruled in heavy ink, with one orange highlighter for whatever is live right now. Every reading sits in a ruled box and every event the bike reports becomes a numbered roadbook row (distance, tulip pictogram, note). Nothing floats, nothing is tinted grey, and nothing casts a shadow. Depth and emphasis come from three moves only: a heavier rule, an ink flood, or a highlighter mark.

The density is a navigator's: big condensed numerals packed into narrow boxes, small typewritten labels in the corners, and a strip of distance ticks running down the left edge of the roll. Motion is part of the system, and every moving part is driven by real telemetry: digits roll like an odometer, the temperature needle slides, the distance strip scrolls at 10 m per tick, the tulip arrow's dash flows with speed. When the system animator scale is 0, all of that stops. The live trip distance keeps updating because it is data, not decoration.

The ground is white because the rider asked for it and because it reads in sunlight. There is no dark scheme and no dynamic colour. The world was derived from the shipped Compose source; it has not been compiled or rendered on a device (no Android SDK was available), so rendered values such as Material's own indicator and switch shapes are unverified.
keyCharacteristics: White roll paper, ink, and a single rally highlighter (#FF5A1F) that marks only what is live.
Square boxes framed in a 2.5dp heavy rule, divided by 1.5dp light rules.
Saira Condensed for numerals, titles and buttons; Roboto Mono for labels, units and notes.
Press blocks that flood with ink and sink 3dp inside their rule; no shadow anywhere.
Every animation is telemetry-driven and goes still when system animations are off.
Glove-sized controls: 56dp minimum for every tappable target.

rules.name: The One Highlighter Rule
rules.body: Orange means "live right now": the current row, the selected tab, the needle, the one action on a screen. If two things on a screen are orange for different reasons, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Ink-On-Orange Rule
rules.body: Text sitting on the highlighter is Ink, never white. On paper the highlighter is a fill or a mark, never text; on an ink ground (the cluster preview, a pressed highlight block's label) highlighter text is allowed at 5.9:1.

rules.name: The Never-Colour-Alone Rule
rules.body: Every state that uses orange also changes shape or words: the status square is filled, empty, breathing or crossed; low fuel adds a LOW or RESERVE tag; stale adds a STALE tag.

rules.name: The Tabular Numeral Rule
rules.body: Every number that changes while riding uses tabular figures (`tnum`), so rolling digits never shift their neighbours.

rules.name: The Label Corner Rule
rules.body: Upper-case is reserved for typewritten box labels, Tags, nav labels and button faces. Titles, notes and body text stay in sentence case.

rules.name: The Ink-Flood Rule
rules.body: Pressing is shown by ink, not light: the face floods with ink and sinks 3dp inside its rule. Nothing lifts, glows or casts a shadow.

dos: **Do** frame every reading or group in a square ink box with a 2.5dp outer rule and 1.5dp inner rules.
**Do** keep the highlighter (#FF5A1F) for what is live right now: the one action, the NOW row, the needle, the selected tab, warning tags.
**Do** put Ink text on highlighter fills, and pair every orange state with a shape or word change.
**Do** make every tappable control at least 56dp tall.
**Do** show presses as an ink flood plus a 3dp inset, with a haptic tick.

**Do** drive every animation from real telemetry, and check `rememberMotionEnabled()` so it goes still when the animator scale is 0. Live data, such as the dead-reckoned trip distance, keeps updating.
**Do** use tabular figures for any number that changes while riding.
**Do** show missing data as "—" and stale data in Soft Ink with a STALE tag, never faded below legibility.
donts: **Don't** add a dark scheme, dynamic colour, or an off-white or grey surface; the white ground is a binding user brief.
**Don't** add shadows, tonal elevation or glows; press blocks show no ripple, only the ink flood.
**Don't** round the corners of boxes, blocks, fields, tags or segments. Pictograms keep their round caps and dots.
**Don't** set highlighter text on paper (3.1:1), or white text on highlighter.
**Don't** use Faint Ink (#D6D6D6) for any readable text.
**Don't** animate anything that is not backed by telemetry or a direct press.
**Don't** use a second accent hue or an icon library; icons are drawn in the tulip stroke.
